Overtime is counted in full hours. The leftover minutes are rounded up to the next full hour only when they are at least `60 − threshold` past the hour:

- threshold 15 → leftover 45–59 min rounds up, 1–44 min does not. So 1:45 → 2h, 1:44 → 1h. ✔ exactly your example
- threshold 10 → 1:50 → 2h, 1:49 → 1h
- threshold 0 → exact hours only (1:59 → 1h)
